blurb: During this 4 hour tour we will spend time visiting President John F. Kennedy's grave site at Arlington National Cemetery, visit the Lincoln Memorial, the White House, and the US Capitol. Take a photo stop at the White House-Lafayette Square and conclude at the US Capitol-West Lawn.  Transportation and Private Guide are included in the price, and the Private Tour can accommodate up to 10 passengers all for the same price. The tour is geared toward those traveling as a family or group of friends or co-workers, not to exceed 10 passengers.
